requirements.summary: A modern, clean landing page featuring a staggered entrance animation. The layout includes a sticky header, a split-pane hero section with text on the left and three side-by-side UI mockups on the right, followed by a logo cloud for investors.
requirements.template_goal: Refine the existing template to perfectly match the reference video's right hero column. The three UI cards must be simplified, positioned side-by-side horizontally (not overlapping), and styled with subtle, faint details.
hard_constraints: The three UI mockup cards in the right hero column must be positioned side-by-side horizontally using flexbox or grid, not overlapping.
The content of the three UI cards must exactly match the simplified visual in the video: CRM (Avatar, Name, 'Requested booking'), EHR (Name, skeleton lines), RCM ('$225,390', faint bar chart).
Each UI card must have a pill label (CRM, EHR, RCM) positioned at its bottom center, slightly overlapping the bottom edge.
The radial gradient pattern overlay in the right hero column must be removed to match the solid color background in the video.
preserve_requirements: The staggered entrance animation sequence and timing logic.
The header layout, styling, and copy.
The left hero column (green card) layout, typography, and 'Request a Demo' button.
The investor logos section layout and opacity hover effects.
The design tokens defined in the Tailwind config.

section_requirements.name: Header
section_requirements.purpose: Site navigation and primary call to action.
section_requirements.layout: Flex container, space-between, items centered vertically.

section_requirements.name: Hero Section - Left Column
section_requirements.layout: Flex column, space between content and button.
copy_items: Admit more patients, reduce staff burden, and get paid faster with an AI-native system built for behavioral healthcare.
behaviors: Card slides up and fades in.

section_requirements.name: Hero Section - Right Column
section_requirements.purpose: Visual hook showing simplified UI mockups.
section_requirements.layout: Flex row, center aligned, gap between cards.
styling: Cards are white, side-by-side, with subtle shadows.
Pills are positioned at the bottom center of each card.
behaviors: Inner white cards slide up sequentially.

section_requirements.name: Investor Logos
section_requirements.layout: Flex column, centered text, flex row for logos wrapping as needed.
must_include: Row of at least 6 investor logos
styling: Logos should be greyscale or visually balanced.
behaviors: Fades in after hero animation completes.

layout_requirements: The right hero column must use a flex container (`flex items-center justify-center gap-6`) to hold the three UI cards side-by-side.
The UI cards should have fixed or relative widths (e.g., `w-[180px]`) to ensure they fit side-by-side without overlapping.
The pill labels on the UI cards should use absolute positioning (`absolute -bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2`) to sit on the bottom edge.
styling_requirements: Remove the `.absolute.inset-0.opacity-[0.04]` div containing the radial gradient from the right hero column.
The RCM card chart bars must be very faint, using a class like `bg-surface-blue/30`.
The EHR card should use simple div elements with background colors to represent skeleton text lines.
The pills should have a light gray background and dark gray text, fully rounded.
copy_requirements: Update the RCM card text to exactly '$225,390'.
Update the EHR card text to 'Emm Smith'.
Update the CRM card text to 'Emma Smith' and 'Requested booking'.
asset_requirements: Use a simple circular div with a background color or a generic SVG icon for the avatar in the CRM card.
behavior_requirements: The animation sequence must remain intact, triggering the new side-by-side cards in the same staggered order (CRM, then EHR, then RCM).
animation_requirements: Sequence 2 (300ms): Left green card and right blue card slide up.
Sequence 3 (600ms): 'Request a Demo' button slides up.
Sequence 7 (1200ms): Investor heading and logos fade in.
structure_guidance: Ensure the new UI cards retain the `data-animate="slide-up"` attribute and their respective `data-card="..."` attributes so the existing JS controller can find and animate them.
execution_plan: 2. Delete the div containing the radial gradient pattern overlay.
3. Delete the three existing absolute-positioned UI cards (`[data-card="crm"]`, `[data-card="ehr"]`, `[data-card="rcm"]`).

4. Add a flex container inside the right hero column: `
`.

5. Inside the flex container, build the new CRM card: White background, relative positioning, flex column. Add an avatar circle, 'Emma Smith' text, 'Requested booking' text, and an absolute-positioned 'CRM' pill at the bottom center. Add `data-animate="slide-up" data-card="crm"`.

6. Build the new EHR card next to it: White background, relative positioning. Add 'Emm Smith' text, 3-4 skeleton lines (`bg-gray-100 rounded-full h-2`), and an absolute-positioned 'EHR' pill at the bottom center. Add `data-animate="slide-up" data-card="ehr"`.

7. Build the new RCM card next to it: White background, relative positioning. Add '$225,390' text, a flex container for the chart with faint bars (`bg-surface-blue/30`), and an absolute-positioned 'RCM' pill at the bottom center. Add `data-animate="slide-up" data-card="rcm"`.
8. Verify that the animation sequence still targets these new cards correctly.
known_unknowns: The exact icon used next to 'Requested booking' in the CRM card (a small generic calendar or clock icon can be used).

interaction_checkpoints.name: Hero Content Appears
interaction_checkpoints.expected_result: The three UI cards (CRM, EHR, RCM) slide up sequentially, appearing side-by-side horizontally within the blue card.

acceptance_criteria: The right hero column has a solid blue background with no pattern.
The three UI cards are positioned side-by-side horizontally with equal spacing.
The CRM card displays an avatar, 'Emma Smith', and 'Requested booking'.
The EHR card displays 'Emm Smith' and skeleton text lines.
The RCM card displays '$225,390' and a faint bar chart.
All three UI cards have a pill label at their bottom center.
The three UI cards animate in sequentially (CRM -> EHR -> RCM).
